title: Paul McCartney live: RBC Center, Raleigh | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the RBC Center in Raleigh, North Carolina, USA, on 7 October 2002.

It was the 37th date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002. This show was seen by 13,916 fans.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the PNC Arena, as the RBC Center was later known, during the Freshen Up Tour on 27 May 2019.
